race.description: Buy A Kosciuszko Ticket Now Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: ZOUCAT (9) stripped fitter last start and can keep the winning momentum going after she scored a tough win over 1006m at Port Macquarie. Gets in light with the claim and can stalk the fast tempo.  DANCE GAVIN DANCE (2) improving gelding with a solid winning record. Sat off the speed and rounded them up with ease when a sharp winner over 1000m at Casino. Kept up to the mark with a 950m trial placing. Winkers go on and he looks to have further upside. THEIR FINEST HOUR (4) sat on the fast tempo in town before he folded up in the straight when last over 1000m at Randwick in Highway grade. No surprise to see him bounce back quickly. KATE'S TIARA (7) big improver when he launched late from back in the field with a slashing second over 1000m at Casino. Stays in the calculations.
